items.html: Afterward, the final Hey of the general SAG is the Malchut of the Partzuf of the general SAG, and she too is like the first Hey, which are three Heys: a Hey in the three first lines, KHB; a Hey in the three middle lines, HGT; a Hey in the three lower lines, NHY. And all these three Heys are in the secret of internality. There is also another set, in the secret of externality, and they are three other Heys, divided in the manner mentioned above.
